convert_mluke_checkpoint: convert an original mLUKE PyTorch checkpoint to HuggingFace LukeForMaskedLM format
load_original_entity_vocab: load an original mLUKE entity vocabulary file and return a language-prefixed entity mapping
run_convert_script_cli: run the mLUKE checkpoint conversion script via argparse CLI with checkpoint and metadata paths
add_special_tokens_to_tokenizer: add entity special tokens <ent> and <ent2> to an XLMRobertaTokenizer for mLUKE
initialize_entity_attention_weights: initialize entity-aware self-attention query weights from original checkpoint for each encoder layer
